operations.name: Get box markdown
operations.description: Returns the box as one markdown document: an overview, its columns, contacts, organizations, linked boxes, tasks and pipeline, followed by its timeline. Every timestamp is ISO-8601 UTC. The document's structure is best-effort and may change; use the JSON endpoints for a stable contract.

maxTokens.description: A token cap for the entire document, counted with OpenAI's o200k_base encoding. It covers the box sections first, then uses the remaining tokens for the timeline. A marker shows where entries were left out. If the box does not fit under the cap, a 400 error shows the minimum it needs. Omit the cap to return the full box.

operations.name: List upcoming tasks
operations.description: Lists tasks across all pipelines and boxes. By default, returns incomplete tasks assigned to the current user before tomorrow in the user's timezone, which includes today's and overdue tasks. Use userKeys, pipelineKey, includeCompleted, direction, limit, and sortOrder to page through other agenda slices.

direction.description: Agenda direction. Accepted values are desc, past, asc, and future. Defaults to desc.

includeCompleted.description: Whether completed tasks should be included in the returned agenda.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return per assigned user.

pipelineKey.description: Key for the pipeline to filter tasks to. Omit to search across all visible pipelines.

sortOrder.description: Opaque 30-digit sort cursor returned as task.sortOrder. Omit to use tomorrow at local midnight as the cursor boundary.

userKeys.description: User keys whose assigned tasks should be returned. Omit to return tasks assigned to the current user.

operations.name: List contacts
operations.description: Lists contacts in stable order. Pass the returned cursor to continue; keep the same after filter across pages. A full last page may be followed by an empty page.

after.description: Include contacts last saved at or after this epoch-seconds timestamp.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous response. Omit or leave blank to start from the beginning.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100. Values above 1000 are capped.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous response. Omit or leave blank to start from the beginning.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100. Values above 1000 are capped.

operations.name: Get contacts in bulk
operations.description: Returns accessible contacts indexed by their requested keys. Missing and inaccessible contacts are omitted.

operations.name: Update contact
operations.description: Applies supplied changes. Null or omitted fields remain unchanged.

givenName.description: New given name; an empty string clears it if another identifier remains.

familyName.description: New family name; an empty string clears it if another identifier remains.

title.description: New job title; an empty string clears it.

other.description: New notes; an empty string clears them.

emailAddresses.description: Replacement email addresses; a contact must retain an email address or a name.

phoneNumbers.description: Replacement phone numbers. Empty entries are removed.

addresses.description: Replacement postal addresses. Empty entries are removed.

fields.description: Custom-field values to merge by field key. Null entries are ignored; an empty map leaves existing fields unchanged.

contactLinks.description: Replacement links to contacts; an empty list removes the links.

orgLinks.description: Replacement links to organizations; an empty list removes the links.

operations.name: Update meeting
operations.description: Updates a meeting or call log by key

meetingType.description: New meeting type. Omit this field to keep the existing meeting type unchanged.

startTimestamp.description: New meeting start timestamp, in epoch milliseconds. Omit this field to keep the existing start time unchanged.

duration.description: New meeting duration in milliseconds. Omit this field to keep the existing duration unchanged.

notes.description: New meeting notes. Omit this field to keep the existing notes unchanged.

isDraft.description: Whether to publish a draft meeting. Omit this field to keep the existing draft state unchanged.

taskKeys.description: Replacement task keys associated with this meeting. Omit this field to keep existing task keys unchanged.

operations.name: Get organizations in a batch
operations.description: Returns organizations keyed by their organization keys. Missing and inaccessible organizations are omitted.

operations.name: Update an organization
operations.description: Updates an organization. Omitted and null properties are unchanged. Supplied lists replace existing lists, subject to field validation.

name.description: Replacement organization name. A name or domain must remain after the update.

other.description: Replacement notes. An empty string clears the notes.

domains.description: Replacement domains, with the primary domain first. An empty list clears domains if a name remains.

phoneNumbers.description: Replacement phone numbers. An empty list clears existing phone numbers.

addresses.description: Replacement postal addresses. An empty list clears existing addresses.

employeeCount.description: Replacement company size as text, including employee-count ranges.

twitterHandle.description: Replacement Twitter profile handle or URL.

facebookHandle.description: Replacement Facebook profile handle or URL.

linkedinHandle.description: Replacement LinkedIn profile handle or URL.

instagramHandle.description: Replacement Instagram profile handle or URL.

contactLinks.description: Replacement contact relationships. An empty list removes existing relationships.

orgLinks.description: Replacement organization relationships. An empty list removes existing relationships.

fields.description: Custom field values to change, keyed by field ID. Omitted keys and null values are unchanged; an empty object makes no changes.

aclEntries.description: Replacement sharing entries. Omit to keep existing sharing; an empty list is invalid.
